messages.subject: Multicollinearity in SEM-models
parts:
Hello,

I want to analyze an SEM by LAVAAN, but I assume multicollinearity among the latent variables (because I find varying "Std.all" when replacing the latent variables in the model). Now, I have two questions:
1) How can I check for multicollinearity? I did not find a function in LAVAAN by which I get a VIF or Tol value
2) How can I analyze the model despite multicollinearity? (Maybe only interpret the covariances?)

Thank you in advance :)

Best regards,
Korbinian
